study type: multicenter, noninterventional, retrospective cohort study with a 12-month prospective follow-up period
cohort: 22 individuals with congenital fibrinogen deficiency who received human fibrinogen concentrate for the treatment of bleeding, perioperative hemostasis, or prophylaxis
finding: In patients with CFD, FCH is a well-tolerated and effective treatment to achieve hemostasis during bleeding events and surgery and associated with infrequent bleeding events when used prophylactically.
